id: title:abhischekt:pin the claim view to the sql that was bound

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse view SQL pinning and dependency checks to account claim binding, potentially preventing row loss if warehouse SQL or dependencies change.
review.reason: The change implements warehouse view SQL pinning and dependency checks. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 add runtime checks and HogQL parsing support; P1.F3.H1, P1.F5.H1, and P1.F6.H1 add database migrations and model fields to persist the SQL digest. P1.F8 and P1.F9 are tests. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse account claims.
review.uncertainty: Tier 2 assigned; Tier 3 not assigned because the implementation does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction across multiple components or critical paths, and no release notes or adoption metrics are supplied. Tier 1 not assigned because the change is substantive and bounded, not merely maintenance or documentation.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single-file change. No other PRs are supplied, so no cross-PR relationship or unrelatedness can be established. No release notes, WPR, adoption or incident context is supplied. The review is limited to this chunk and this file only.

observations.behavior: Adds a SHA-256 pin of the warehouse view SQL at binding and checks it on every run; also checks that the view does not depend on saved queries or fields defined outside its SQL.
observations.code_quote: The pin covers the view's own text only. A view that reads another saved query is refused, because
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a warehouse view from returning rows after its SQL or dependencies change, potentially blocking account claims or releases. The implementation checks the SQL hash and dependency graph, not just the view name.

observations.behavior: Adds imports for HogQL parsing, resolution and visitor traversal, and the database context, to support checking SQL and dependencies.
observations.posthog_connection: These imports are required to parse and resolve the pinned SQL and detect dependencies. Without them, the checks cannot execute.

observations.behavior: Updates the ClaimSourceMisconfigured exception docstring to include failure reasons: SQL changed, or dependencies outside the SQL.
observations.code_quote: a warehouse source can change the rows. The claim rules still limit such rows to empty roles, active
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the failure modes for account claim binding and execution, including warehouse source changes and dependency violations.

observations.behavior: Adds a new database field and migration, and a hash field to store the SQL digest of a warehouse view at binding.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a migration to persist the SQL digest, supporting the binding and pinning workflow.

observations.behavior: Adds a model field to store the SQL digest, with a comment explaining its purpose.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores the SHA-256 of the warehouse view's SQL at binding, used to detect SQL changes.

observations.behavior: Adds a parameter to the test factory and updates the saved query creation to use the SQL string directly.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates test setup to support warehouse views with SQL strings, not just HogQL metadata.
